engineContractSha256.description: SHA-256 of exact public Engine contracts/releases/qa-contract-<engineVersion>.json bytes; not the runtime file manifest or npm tarball hash.

name.description: Safe ASCII slash-separated path relative to isolated document root; reject absolute/UNC/backslash/traversal/symlink/case-fold collisions.

blueprintJson.description: Opaque Engine JSON; exact public Engine schema, UTF-8 byte/depth limits and immutable snapshot validation apply.

engineContractSha256.description: SHA-256 of exact public Engine contracts/releases/qa-contract-<engineVersion>.json bytes; not the runtime file manifest or npm tarball hash.

engineEventJson.description: Opaque Engine JSON; exact public Engine schema, UTF-8 byte/depth limits and immutable snapshot validation apply.

resultJson.description: Opaque Engine JSON; exact public Engine schema, UTF-8 byte/depth limits and immutable snapshot validation apply.

ReconcileResponse.description: Maximum serialized response 8 MiB. Server sizes each page by bytes and count; one serialized Lease is capped at 7 MiB. Follow all nextCursor pages before deciding to claim. validForMs is recomputed remaining TTL at this response, anchored by Agent request-start monotonic time.

name.description: Safe ASCII slash-separated path relative to isolated document root; reject absolute/UNC/backslash/traversal/symlink/case-fold collisions.

receipts.description: Only outstanding/unacknowledged completion receipts. Server records receipt acknowledgements transactionally across pages/calls and independently verifies every owned lease terminal, evidence and cleanup. Not an all-history list.

ownerStopped.description: Same instance: every Engine child stopped and new claims disabled while supervisor awaits release ACK. Different reporter: additionally verified old owner OS process absent. Unknown ownership forbids release.

released.description: False acknowledges this bounded receipt batch but keeps the owner; true only when all owned leases are independently releasable.

items.description: Canonical public Engine action name for the pinned release; server and local capability allowlists intersect. Aliases are forbidden.

resourceKey.description: Must equal Lease.resourceKey; resolves only through registered local physical device/browser slot mapping.

items.description: Exact normalized http(s) origin. Empty denies all web navigation.

allowProduction.description: Production execution requires BOTH this server policy and explicit local opt-in. Missing means deny.

x-policy: Agent execution scope is the intersection of server ExecutionPolicy, registered allowlists, local device/origin/app/secret configuration and pinned Engine capabilities. Empty lists grant nothing. Appium connection URLs and secret values are local configuration only.
